Built with

HTMLCSSJavaScript REST APIsGeolocation APIOpenStreetMap

02 / GRAPH ANALYSIS

Intelligent Workflow Verification Framework

MVP for analyzing enterprise workflow structures and finding logical issues.

Source Code ↗

Problem

Enterprise workflows can contain deadlocks, circular dependencies, unreachable states, and structural errors before deployment.

Built with

PythonStreamlitNetworkXMatplotlibJSON

What I built

  • Workflow parsing and dependency graph generation.
  • Rule validation and graph-based deadlock detection.
  • Circular-dependency and unreachable-state detection.
  • Structural analysis and visualization.

Result

An MVP that analyzes workflow structures, identifies logical and structural issues, visualizes dependencies, and assesses workflow quality.
